title: Operation: Find Socks' Missing Sock
subtitle: The smallest mystery needs the biggest team

pages.text: Socks stood in the hallway with one bare foot. "My sock!" she wailed. "It was here and now it's GONE!" Bluey pulled on imaginary detective glasses. "This is a case for Detective Bluey."

Lia arrived with a notebook. "Chief Clue Spotter reporting." Bingo found muddy footprints by the back door — tiny, wobbly, definitely Socks-shaped. Muffin pointed at the washing machine. "Guilty!" she declared.

Bandit searched the fridge. "Not in here. But I found last week's sandwich." Chilli raised an eyebrow. "Leave that mystery for another day." They checked the toy box, the couch, and under Bandit's hat.
Outside, Lia spotted a clue on the clothesline — one lonely striped sock, dancing in the breeze! "Found it!" she cheered. But Socks shook her head. "Nope. That's my OTHER lonely sock."
Bluey studied the trail. Mud to the sandpit. Sand to the slide. Slide to... the dog bed? They tiptoed closer. A soft snoring came from inside. Not Socks. Someone else.
It was Lucky the neighbour's cat, curled around the missing sock like a fluffy doughnut. Socks gasped. "Kitty found it!" Lucky opened one eye, unimpressed. Bandit offered a treat. Trade accepted.
Socks pulled on both socks and did a victory wiggle. Chilli smiled. "I knew where it was all along." Everyone stared. "I wanted you to solve it together," she winked.

THE END

Detective badge for you: draw three places YOU would search for a lost sock. Don't forget the dog bed!
